text: DAINIK BHASKAR

Daily games
for the news reader
Five proposed experiences, with a clear reason for each
Pitch review   /   13 October 2026

Design basis: user feedback of 13 October 2026 and Doc/Bhaskar Daily Games Design Rationale.md. Proposed benefits remain hypotheses. No player testing or measured retention results are available.
Presenter: We are proposing a small daily collection. The first three concepts have clearer roles today. This pitch explains what Carrom and Jodi must add to justify the extra scope.
Why five games?
Each addition must serve a need the others leave open.
The test: do Carrom and Jodi add value beyond the first three?

Why a Hindi word game?
Aaj Ka Shabd  /  आज का शब्द
A short word challenge turns familiar Hindi into a daily puzzle.
The Bhaskar connection
The reveal explains the word, then offers a specific related story.
What makes tomorrow different?
A new curated word. Improvement through fewer guesses and a personal solve history.

Aaj Ki Niti  /  आज की नीति
Choose the missing phrase, reveal its meaning, and create a card worth sharing.

Why replay a cricket moment?

A six-ball situation gives the reader a clear target and a brief moment of pressure.

The Rajesh persona follows cricket. Proposed integration: a verified current or archive equation provides context. Keep authored practice and historical situations distinct. A last over is not necessarily a tie-breaking Super Over. Screenshot: Doc/review-images/superover-start-simplified.jpg.
Why add Carrom after cricket?
Aaj Ka Nishana  /  आज का निशाना
Aiming and pocketing offer a familiar skill challenge without needing cricket knowledge.
A different board each day
A player can try a small Carrom challenge alone, without arranging a physical game.
Completion first, fewer shots next
Keep playing until the objective is complete. Count every shot, then offer a better-score replay.

title: What makes Jodi more than matching?

text: What makes Jodi more than matching?
Aaj Ki Jodi  /  आज की जोड़ी
Match four relationships from selected news: a person and achievement, or an event and place.
The explanation earns the interaction
Each correct pair reveals why the connection matters and links to its relevant story.
A useful reason to share
Invite someone to try the same edition with a spoiler-free result. Four pairs are a small discovery.

title: Does Jodi compete with the news?

text: Does Jodi compete with the news?
It could, if four pairs imply that the reader knows the whole story.
The proposed promise

आज की खबरों से
चार बातें समझीं
The article adds what matching cannot

Why it happened, what changed, and what it means for the reader.

Each pair offers a direct route to that context.
Test understanding and article engagement against the ordinary reading journey.

Design basis: user feedback of 13 October 2026 and Doc/Bhaskar Daily Games Design Rationale.md. Proposed benefits remain hypotheses. No player testing or measured retention results are available.
Editorial guardrails: verified source and publication date on every pair, truthful freshness labels, optional article links, and no claim that the user has consumed all important news. Sensitive suffering should not become a scored matching game. Whether Jodi complements or substitutes for reading is unknown until tested.
What brings the reader back?
One game can be enough for today. The next edition provides the invitation to return.

Design basis: user feedback of 13 October 2026 and Doc/Bhaskar Daily Games Design Rationale.md. Proposed benefits remain hypotheses. No player testing or measured retention results are available.
Target sessions are brief, typically about 1–3 minutes, but unlimited Carrom attempts can take longer. Fresh content is a proposed return mechanism, not evidence of retention. One game completed is sufficient for daily participation. Avoid cross-board comparisons in Carrom.

title: How will we know five is worth it?

text: How will we know five is worth it?
Three clearer concepts give us a base. Carrom and Jodi must show what they add.
Carrom earns its place if…
It attracts readers the other games miss, or gives them a distinct reason to return.
Jodi earns its place if…
Readers understand the connections better than from a short summary, with a useful path into reporting.
Five remains a testable proposal. Reader evidence should determine the final collection.

Source: supplied Doc/Dainik Bhaskar Game Lab 2026.pdf, pp. 7, 9–11, 13–18. This is the organizer brief. The separate root-level GBL document is a project design document, not a requirement to submit five games.
Design basis: user feedback of 13 October 2026 and Doc/Bhaskar Daily Games Design Rationale.md. Proposed benefits remain hypotheses. No player testing or measured retention results are available.
Suggested evaluation: compare a three-game collection (Shabd, Niti, Over) against five with comparable exposure, and compare Jodi with a text summary containing the same facts. Observe comprehension, starts, completions, voluntary return, article engagement and editorial preparation effort. Do not choose sample size or success thresholds without a research plan.
